sources.title: GRID3 NGA - Settlement Extents v4.1
sources.notes:
The GRID3 NGA - Settlement Extents v4.1 dataset consists of a geographic representation of settlements in Nigeria. Settlement extents are further delineated into settlement blocks nested within urban and small settlement areas, generated from integrated road, railway, river, building footprints, and remote-sensing inputs. Each block is enriched with morphological, environmental, and building metrics.

This version supersedes the GRID3 NGA - Settlement Extents v4.0. The following changes were made:

- Revision of block delineation methodology resulting in new block geometries.
- Removal of hamlets and edge-blocks with zero-building count
- Addition of airports to the block classifications and removal of es_class (extent size) from the attributes and classification.


Dataset citation:
Center for Integrated Earth System Information (CIESIN), Columbia University. 2026. GRID3 NGA - Settlement Extents v4.1. New York: Columbia University. [download url here]. Accessed [DAY MONTH YEAR].

Contacts and data queries:
The authors of this dataset appreciate feedback regarding the data, including suggestions, discovery of errors, difficulties in using the data, and format preferences. For dataset-related questions, please send an email to: info@ciesin.columbia.edu

sources.title: GRID3 SEN - Settlement Extents v3.0
sources.notes:
The GRID3 SEN - Settlement Extents v3.0 consists of a geographic representation of settlements in Senegal, in two forms:
(1) settlement polygons, and 
(2) spatial points depicting the centroids of settled grid cells at 3-arc seconds (or ~100 meters) contained within settlement polygons. 

Both layers include attributes as described in the codebooks. 

The current version supersedes GRID3 Senegal Settlement Extents, Version 02; the following changes were made:
(1) Development of a new methodology to derive building counts and settlement polygons with open data.
(2) Estimation of a probability value for settlement polygons
(3) Addition of a building-area measure
(4) Replacement of degree of urbanization with classification based on built-up areas, small settlement areas, and hamlets
(5) Elimination of building-count ranges
(6) Elimination of variable comparing to previous versions

Recommended Citation:
Center for International Earth Science Information Network (CIESIN), Columbia University. 2024. GRID3 SEN - Settlement Extents v3.0. New York: GRID3. [URL]. Accessed [DAY MONTH YEAR].
